papers.title: Verified Scientific Discovery
papers.current_ceiling: The bounded protected-authority result is the strongest supported empirical object: H1 and H2 pass; H3 is NOT_SUPPORTED and retained.
post_matrix_updates: The exact compile/reduct work is on main, but the absent 400-row table remains CANNOT_CHECK_ARTIFACT_ABSENT and must not be synthetically reconstructed.
load_bearing_adverse: H3 is NOT_SUPPORTED and cannot be converted to a positive mechanism claim.
The 400-row reduct table is absent; filing is not blocked on it, but no reconstruction is permitted.

papers.strongest_remaining_gap: For a broader top-tier claim, the specification-separated governance mechanism must preserve its false-promotion advantage across qualitatively different objective verifiers and identify which components are load-bearing.
papers.decisive_question: Using one unchanged governance rule across Defects4J, Lean/mathlib and RO-Crate, does specification separation eliminate false scientific promotion while preserving clean-case coverage against a donor-complete control product?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Specification-separated scientific governance transfers across objective-verifier domains, preventing false promotion without becoming an always-abstain system.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The unchanged governance mechanism should maintain zero false promotions, noninferior clean coverage and a superior safety/coverage frontier across E3, E12 and E7; the old H3 null remains outside this claim.
papers.population_or_universe: Prospectively frozen, paper-disjoint objective-verifier cases from E3, E12 and E7, including positive, null, subsumed, invalid and non-identifiable cases.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A candidate scientific decision/case × governance arm.
historical_only_inputs: The protected 360/60 cases and the absent 400-row table
design: Freeze domain mappings to a common promotion contract.
Use objective native verifiers wherever possible and external adjudication only for residual semantics.
Keep the same governance rule across all domains.
Include simple fail-closed and always-abstain references to expose metric gaming.
Predeclare component ablations and utility costs.
primary_endpoints: False promotion, with zero as a noncompensatory gate.
Resource cost and ablation-specific false-promotion change.
negative_controls: Verifier outage or ambiguous case yielding CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Domain-specific exact/paired estimates and hierarchical synthesis.
H3 remains reported as NOT_SUPPORTED regardless of successor outcome.
Ablation family and multiplicity are frozen.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Use all eligible cases under each pinned source where feasible; otherwise power domain-cluster effects and guarantee enough clean and unsafe cases per domain before outputs.
papers.success_gate: Zero false promotions, clean coverage noninferior to the donor product and useful-promotion advantage in at least two domains with no catastrophic failure in the third.
papers.refutation_gate: Any false promotion or always-abstain-equivalent behaviour defeats the broad claim; null transfer leaves the bounded H1/H2 result intact.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if objective gold, channel separation or protected-case custody cannot be verified.
papers.authority_required: Native verifiers and, where needed, blinded external domain adjudication separated from system generation.

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not reconstruct the absent 400-row table or alter H3; the external study is a separate identity.

immediate_safe_actions: Re-render the journal package and rerun claim-to-PDF audit.
Create a cross-domain promotion-contract mapping table.
Design blinded residual adjudication for cases without native binary gold.
forbidden_actions: Do not turn H3 into support.
Do not claim safety from an always-abstain comparator win.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier AI/science-governance paper needs multi-domain objective authority, zero catastrophic promotion errors, useful coverage, strong donor products and causal ablations.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns verified promotion mechanism; programme-level longitudinal research governance belongs to ORION-24.
